description: Fork of exp349 (bs=96 winner: 1.4478 @ 43.1M, noise=0.002, adam_lr=3e-4 global). Two stacked changes: (a) argmax_noise_eps 0.002 -> 0.0 (per exp352 finding at bs=16: noise=0 beat noise=0.002 by -0.006 bpb); (b) lut_lr=1e-3 split from adam_lr=3e-4 (per exp353/exp359 finding at bs=16: -0.007 to -0.010 bpb). Stacks the two best optimizer-side findings of the day on top of the best bs=96 result. Reference: exp349 = 1.4478; if both findings transfer to bs=96, expect 1.43-1.435 range. New tiny-LUT SOTA candidate.
